conditions_locator: Materials pp 2908–2909; Admicellar Polymerization and Table 1 p 2909; TG Test and LOI Test p 2910
source_location: Whole original six-page publisher article, pp 2908–2913, methods, Tables 1/2, Figures 1–3, conclusions and all references reviewed. Original recipe/method/Table 2/Figure 3 pixels inspected. No graph digitization.
sample_state: CF-PVPA-1; 0.30 mM vinyl phosphonic acid; no binding agent; preparation-rinsed, no durability wash assigned
treatment_chemistry: Poly(vinyl phosphonic acid) coating formed by CTAB-aided admicellar polymerization using AIBA initiator; no binding agent
treatment_method: Supplied commercial fabric used as received; source 1.84 g, 16 × 5 cm piece in a 32 mL vial with 30 mL aqueous 0.8 mM CTAB solution. Table 1 vinyl phosphonic acid concentration 0.30 mM, binding agent Nil. Representative recipe specifies vinyl phosphonic acid 0.30 mM and AIBA 0.30 mM; other per-row initiator concentrations not independently given. Sealed vial shaken at 30 °C for 15 h for admicelle formation and monomer adsolubilization, then 80 °C for 24 h polymerization. Cool to ambient, rinse with hot distilled water to remove labile CTAB, air-dry, then dry overnight at 60 °C.
pairing_evidence: Table 1 uniquely defines CF-PVPA-1 by monomer concentration, binder status and measured phosphorus content. Both tests explicitly use the corresponding prepared fabric; no post-treatment durability branch is transferred.
limitations: Six independently reviewed treated source states. Table 2 gives exact measured LOI/T10 for matching fabric labels. The source calls T10wt% an onset; map it only to T10, not Tonset. All DTG column temperatures are retained in raw fields because the text does not separately define their maximum-rate and stage semantics; DTA endotherms and stage mass losses are excluded from canonical TG metrics. CF-PVPA-3 residue is held because Table 2, thermal prose and abstract say 28.2% at 600 °C but the conclusion says 28.2% at 60 °C; no typo correction, while its independent T10 remains available. Figure 3 has a Weight loss (%) axis label but descending curves start near 100; preserve the mislabeled-axis issue and do not derive values from its coordinates. The TG method explicitly describes nitrogen TG and Table 2 separates TG, DTG and DTA, yet the named instrument is DSCQ10 (DSC Thermal Analyzer); this unresolved instrument description is retained verbatim rather than corrected or replaced from another paper. The AIBA 0.30 mM value occurs in the representative 0.30 mM monomer recipe; per-row initiator concentrations beyond that recipe and binding-agent quantity are unreported. The rinse belongs to preparation; no durability washing is reported in this paper. Table 1 P percentages are measured by the described digestion/spectrophotometric procedure; they are not coating mass add-ons. CF-Control repeats the exact LOI/T10/DTG/R600 tuple in related DOI 10.14233/ajchem.2022.23915 and remains separately reuse-held rather than being admitted twice. Distinct 2009 APP/PER/melamine states and a 2016 washable polyester/cotton control were included in the reuse audit; their unresolved source identifiers remain held. No assays or numeric values are borrowed from cited earlier studies.
